message: The other day, I was trying to explain to my grandkids why we need to stock up on snacks before a storm hits. My grandson looked at me with his big eyes and said, "But Grandma, what if we just eat all the snacks before it even starts?" I had to laugh because, honestly, that’s a real possibility in our house! I guess the lesson here is to not only prepare for the storms but also for the little ones’ appetites. What’s your go-to storm snack to keep the kids busy? 🍿
